name: 九尾狐

notes: Final 1920x1080 performance, interaction, security, catalog and console gate.
51.110-second fixed Mandarin reading using the shared mandarin-tingting-r160-v1 voice profile; browser speech synthesis is not a release fallback.
上一版 16:9 青丘环境板；视觉合格，但作为屏幕背景不会随 OrbitControls 方位旋转。
1774x887 原生 2:1 等距青丘全景；作为 Three.js background 与 environment 使用，支持连续 360° 环视。
左右边缘归一化 RMSE 为 0.0332557；浏览器四方位拖拽未见垂直接缝。
记录全景投影、接缝、OrbitControls 四方位、性能和控制台验收。
1200x900 current Three.js v9 release frame using the brighter equirectangular scene and a tighter full-creature composition.
Preserved former dark v3 preview; replaced because it no longer represented the current lighting, environment or framing.
Documented quadruped rig-check and rig succeeded structurally with one skin and 60 joints.
Rejected visually because low tail and hind-body deformation fragmented and dragged during the preset gait.
Structurally valid and stable, but rejected because non-locomotion action amplitudes were too subtle for the release quality bar.
Passed structural and visual animation QC; superseded only to add glTF accessor bounds and remove loader warnings.
Seven playable clips drive 16 localized semantic morph targets across head, spine, legs and the continuous nine-tail field.
The v9 rebuild retains the repaired alternating gait while amplifying airborne pounce, lateral dodge, head motion and nine-tail counter-motion.
All morph POSITION accessors include min/max bounds; browser readability evidence passes the new locomotion and signature-motion gates.
Quantified v9 regional displacement plus real Three.js pounce and dodge peak evidence.
Identity/material reference only; not a provider input.
Rejected by model gate: rear turntable exposes duplicated tail fans and eighteen tail ends.
Added after model attempt 1 to constrain one nine-tail rear fan.
Rejected by model gate: rear turntable shows eleven tail ends with five stacked centrally.
Matched direct opposite of the rear topology-lock view; one explicit 1+4+4 tail fan.
Rejected by model gate: direct-opposite inputs collapse depth and generate a flattened doubled body with invalid side anatomy.
First Rodin result to pass eight-direction anatomy review; preserved unchanged as the provider original.
Closed manifold selected source with 91,600 triangles and three 4096x4096 PBR textures.
Differs from raw-v4.glb only by audited removal of one duplicate terminal triangle; no anatomy changed.
Canonical traits and creature-specific anatomy_profile persisted before image generation.
Rodin Gen-2 source task submitted only after reference QC passed; Quad high with 4K HighPack PBR and two concat-mode provider views.
Reference QC revision 2 adds a genuine rear topology-lock view after attempt 1 exposed duplicated tail geometry.
Reference QC revision 3 replaces side/oblique conditioning with a matched direct-front/direct-rear 1+4+4 pair after attempt 2 still generated eleven tails.
Reference QC revision 4 selects shallow-front body volume plus rear topology lock after attempt 3 proved direct-opposite depth collapse.
Rodin attempt 4 and its audited closed-manifold derivative pass source model and detail gates.
Tripo quadruped rigging passed structurally, but the provider walk failed visual deformation QC and remains preserved as a rejection.
The selected deterministic fallback contains 16 localized morph targets and seven visually validated actions; v9 passes explicit locomotion and signature-motion visibility gates.
The readable interface keeps pinyin only over the creature name, provides formal detailed copy and Mandarin narration, and supports previous/next action navigation.
Shared key/fill/rim lighting and the brighter scene palette keep the creature readable through roaming turns; the v2 equirectangular Qingqiu environment now follows the full 360-degree camera orbit.
共享沉浸模式可隐藏非必要覆盖层并通过点击或 Esc 退出；正常模式按钮与返回图鉴使用完全相同的计算样式。
共享顶部从 ready 图鉴顺序动态生成上一个/下一个神兽入口；第一只禁用上一个、最后一只禁用下一个，新神兽上架后无需编写专属导航。
首页使用当前真实 Three.js 页面的 1200x900 神兽预览，并让卡片列表从容器左侧开始排列。
